post.yt_desc:
Costco sold $297.2 billion of goods in fiscal 2026 but made about half of its $11.69 billion operating income from $5.9 billion in membership fees. We break down the deal, the numbers from Costco's filings, how Price Club and Costco built the model, the clever parts like 92.3% renewal rates and the Executive upgrade math, and the risks. No stock tips, just the business model.
